rights.conclusion: The saved item-level CC BY-NC-SA notices and first-party delivery routes support a qualified operational decision to acquire the exact four objects into restricted storage for genuinely noncommercial research, perform local processing/candidate mining, and conduct restricted human annotation with attribution and safeguards. MIT provides the strongest explicit support because its saved terms expressly address compliant noncommercial AI/ML training. overclaim_flags: Do not describe any source as fully rights-cleared. The licenses cover only rights held or licensed by the publisher; third-party components and privacy, publicity, moral-right, and trademark interests may remain.

Do not state that CC BY-NC-SA itself prohibits public release. The project is withholding public release because component-level scope, privacy/personality, attribution/share-alike packaging, and downstream artifact compatibility have not been completed.

Do not characterize container metadata plus sparse interleaving as perceptual or semantic lip-sync validation. It establishes technical co-timed A/V presence; decoded semantic modality review remains later work.
Do not claim full-file cryptographic identity. URL, length, ETag, Last-Modified, MIME, and range consistency identify the remote rendition; no complete-object SHA-256 was computed.
Do not treat the READY decision as legal advice, human-gold status, or Gate A approval.
authorized: A separate, controlled acquisition task may download exactly one identified first-party rendition for each selected source into restricted project storage.
The acquired copies may be used only for genuinely noncommercial internal research, local ML processing, candidate-family mining, and restricted human annotation.
Attribution, license/version metadata, exact source identity, access controls, minimization, and component/privacy flags must be preserved.
Potential third-party or privacy-sensitive intervals may be inspected only as necessary to identify, exclude, quarantine, or seek separate clearance for them.
prohibited_or_not_yet_authorized: Acquisition from YouTube, Vimeo, Internet Archive, mirrors, guessed URLs, or any route other than the frozen first-party routes.
Public redistribution or release of full media, clips, frames, audio, transcripts, annotations, embeddings, or derived features.
Publication of identifiable student/audience material, third-party readings, figures, images, marks, music, or quoted literary material without separate clearance.
Calling any annotation human gold or starting the scientific mini-pilot solely on this dossier decision.
Any claim that Gate A, Gate B, the end-to-end diagnostic, scaled review, or benchmark release is authorized.
